artworks.title: God Forbids to Eat from the Tree
artworks.description: This print shows three people with pale skin. On the left are a man and a woman, both depicted fully nude. They stand closely together on the left side of the image, facing the right where the third person stands. The woman has long, wavy hair that falls past her shoulders, and the man has curly, short hair. The third person, situated on the right, is an older man, cloaked in a long, flowing robe. He has long hair and a beard, and his clothing is detailed, featuring elaborate folds and patterns. He is positioned with one arm raised upward, pointing with his index finger. The background consists of large tree trunks with thick foliage and round fruit overhead, along with small stones on the ground beneath the bare feet of the people.

artworks.title: The Temptation by the Snake
artworks.description: The image shows two nude figures, a man and a woman, standing side by side. The man is on the right holding a fruit and the woman is on the left holding a fruit and presenting it to the man. The man has curly hair and the woman has long flowing hair. They are surrounded by a lush environment with a tree on the right and a serpent descending from its thick trunk towards the figures. In the background, there is more foliage and a lion's head subtly integrated at the base of the tree.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve Hide Themselves
artworks.description: The image shows two predominantly nude figures alongside a third figure cloaked in robes. The nudity is partially obscured by strategic positioning and gestures. The two nude figures, a male and female, stand closely together, slightly turned toward the cloaked figure, with their arms directed toward their bodies. Both have curly hair, with the male's hair being more prominent. The third person, an older male, has long wavy hair and a beard, and he is depicted gesturing towards the other two with one hand. He wears a flowing robe that drapes over his figure. The background is composed of large, elaborately detailed tree trunks with abundant foliage. Pebbles and rocks are scattered across the foreground.

artworks.title: Expulsion from Paradise
artworks.description: The image shows three figures outdoors. On the left, a male figure with curly hair is covering his lower body. Next to him, a woman with long hair is standing with her hands clasped near her chest. On the right, an angelic figure with large wings, curly hair, and a serious expression is holding a sword aloft with one hand while gesturing with the other. The background includes large trees with textured bark and dense foliage.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve at Work
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in an outdoor setting. On the left, a person stands slightly bent while holding a wooden object. They have curly hair and wear a sleeveless garment. To the right, another person is seated, holding a child. The seated person has long hair and wears a similar garment. The child is wrapped in their embrace. The background features trees and plants. The image is detailed and shaded. In the top right corner, there is a rectangular space with lines and a symbol.

artworks.title: David Casting Off His Robes at the News of the Death of His Son
artworks.description: The image shows three men, one seated and two standing. The seated man has a beard, expressive eyebrows, and a turban-like headpiece. He wears a robe and holds a staff. The man closest to him has a balding head, a beard, a mustache, and wears a formal garment. The third man wears a hat. Their attire is detailed with elaborate patterns and gathered sleeves. The background includes textured elements and architectural columns on the right side.

artworks.title: Susanna Surprised by the Two Elders
artworks.artist: anonymous Germany 16th Century after Heinrich Aldegrever
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nude figure beside a fountain in a medieval town setting. The image shows a seated nude figure next to a fountain with a curved water spout running into a large pitcher. The background features the architecture of a medieval town, including buildings with visible bricks, arches, and a clock on a structure on the left-hand side. A tree is positioned to the right of the fountain, and in the distance, two figures can be seen beyond a small pool, one of whom appears to be gesturing or holding an object. The style features intricate line work and textures typical of early Renaissance etchings.

artworks.title: Susanna Surprised by the Two Elders
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a historic, architectural setting with a nude figure and a fountain. The drawing features a stone building with a sundial on the side, a coil of cloth draped over a ledge, and a fountain with water flowing into a jug. The figure, a woman, is seated beside the fountain. In the background, the architecture has towers and numerous windows, suggesting a medieval or Renaissance European city. A tree with sprawling branches adds to the verticality of the composition. There are two smaller figures in the center. The artist uses intricate line work to depict textures and forms, providing a rich sense of depth and detail.

artworks.title: The Two Elders Before the Judge
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient court scene. It features a group of figures in a classical architectural setting with columns and archways. The central figure is seated on a raised platform, surrounded by other standing or seated figures engaging in conversation. The composition is detailed, with strong use of line and shadow to create depth and texture. The figures are dressed in draped garments.

artworks.title: The Two Elders Convicted by the Testimony of Daniel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered in an architectural setting. The scene depicts intricately dressed individuals in a room with columns and adorned with drapery and banners hanging from the ceiling. The room has a domed ceiling and a circular window. The figures appear to be engaged in conversation or a narrative event, expressed through their dynamic gestures and attentive postures. The composition is detailed, with emphasis on the folds of the fabric, textures of hair, and the structure of the surroundings.

artworks.title: The Two Elders Stoned by the People
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a muscular figure with his arms bound and suspended from chains attached to a stone column. The figure is in a distressed position, with his feet barely touching the ground. Surrounding him, several onlookers observe intently, their expressions a mix of curiosity and indifference. The characters are clad in Renaissance-style clothing. The use of fine linework and detailed shading creates a sense of depth and gravity, showcasing the artist's skill in capturing realism and human emotion.

artworks.title: Traveler among Thieves
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene with several figures surrounding a fallen man. The scene is set in a rugged landscape with rocky cliffs and gnarled trees. The central figure is on the ground, with others around him. The figures are wearing historical attire, with armor and hats. Intricate line work creates texture, highlighting the dramatic moment.

artworks.title: The Good Samaritan Ministering to the Traveler
artworks.description: This is an illustration of two men in a rugged landscape. One man is tending to the other, who appears injured and is lying on the ground. Surrounding them are rocks and trees, with a third figure walking away. The detailed drawing showcases textures such as rocks, fabric, and leaves. In the background, a cityscape is nestled between hills.

artworks.title: The Good Samaritan Placing the Traveler on a Mule
artworks.description: A drawing featuring a man, a horse, buildings, and a landscape. The man and horse are near a large tree and rocky formation. In the background, there are buildings with architectural details. The landscape includes various trees, figures, and buildings in the distance. The drawing is detailed with fine lines typical of engraving techniques.

artworks.title: The Good Samaritan Paying for the Lodgings  of the Traveler
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals and a donkey. The central figure is a man seated on the donkey, extending his arm towards an older man standing next to him. The older man is looking at his hand. A third person stands partially visible between them. The donkey has a bridle and is standing calmly. In the background, there is an architectural structure with a visible door and windows with open shutters. A curved archway provides a view into a dimly lit interior space, where a person lies in bed covered with a blanket, with two other figures nearby. Stone pavement and hints of a town structure make up the background.

artworks.title: The Rich Man at the Table
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a banquet scene set in a classical setting. It shows elegantly dressed individuals feasting around a table filled with various dishes and goblets. The people are interacting with each other, and there is movement and conversation in the scene. On the left side, a figure is dispensing a dish, and a nude figure is reclining in a wooden tub in the foreground. The setting appears to be outdoors, with trees in the background. The composition features detailed linework, typical of Renaissance engraving, capturing the opulence and lively atmosphere of the gathering.

artworks.title: The Rich Man on His Death Bed
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures gathered around a canopied bed. An elderly man is lying on the bed while an old man in a cap and robe sits beside him with a book. Another person with a long, narrowing face holding large goblets stands next to the bed. Additional figures with head coverings and robes are standing around, some gesturing or conversing. In the background, there are architectural elements resembling a village or town square with small human figures interacting.

artworks.title: The Rich Man Being Carried Away by the Devil
artworks.description: This is a painting of fantastical creatures in a rocky landscape. Various mythical and grotesque creatures are depicted engaged in different activities. Two horned, humanoid figures with fur on their legs stand near a cliff on the right side. Below them, a beastly creature with a humanoid form but an animalistic head crouches and wields an axe-like tool. A winged being is shown flying above, carrying another figure. The background shows a distant landscape with a castle-like structure on a hill and a tree in the foreground rocks. The scene has a dark and otherworldly atmosphere reminiscent of Hieronymus Bosch's style.

artworks.title: The Rich Man in Hell
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting two realms. On the left side, there is a creature with horns in flames, grasping another figure. The lower scene is chaotic. On the right side, angels are above a serene sky, carrying a calm figure. The upper scene is peaceful. Below, there is a landscape with trees and a castle, representing the earthly plane.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body view of three individuals and part of the body of Christ on the cross. Christ is positioned centrally, with his arms spread and nailed to the cross, and his head slightly bowed. He has a crown of thorns, wavy hair, a solemn facial expression, and a lean build. Christ's body is mostly unclothed, with a cloth covering his waist. He is surrounded by three figures; on the left is a woman with a solemn expression, possibly Mary, shown in profile with her head covered in a veil. She has her hands clasped in prayer. On the right is a man with long hair, likely John, holding his hands together, wearing a robe, and looking towards Christ. Below Christ's feet is a skull. The background features Latin inscriptions on panels beside Christ's arms, a landscape visible in the distance behind Christ, and a plain sky above. The artwork's intricate line work and shading create a sense of depth.

artworks.title: The Virgin with the Child on the Crescent
artworks.description: The image depicts a standing woman holding a child. The woman is angled slightly to the left and looking down towards the child, who is nestled in her arms with a direct gaze outward. She has long, wavy hair and wears a crown with leaves. The woman's attire is flowing with detailed folds and drapery. The child is mostly unclothed with curly hair. Both figures are surrounded by light. The background shows distant landscapes, including a hill, buildings near water, and a boat on water. The woman is standing on a crescent moon.

artworks.title: The Virgin Seated
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated, holding an infant. The woman has her body turned to the side, cradling the child. She has closed eyes and a serene expression, with long, wavy hair and a decorative band. She wears a detailed gown with a brooch. The infant is unclothed. There is a potted plant nearby, and the setting includes a stone surface, rustic wooden fence, and landscaped scenery in the background. The image is rendered in a monochromatic style with emphasis on line and texture.

artworks.title: Madonna in a Landscape Sitting on a Cushion
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a seated woman holding an infant in her lap. The woman is slightly angled towards the viewer, looking down at the child with gentle expression. She has soft facial features, wavy shoulder-length hair with a veil, and is dressed in a richly textured gown. The baby has curly hair and is reclining against the woman's chest. In the background, there is a landscape with hills and a structure resembling a small tower or church.

artworks.title: Matthew
artworks.description: The image shows two figures seated amongst clouds. The central figure is an individual with long hair and a beard, exhibiting aged features and expressive eyes. He is dressed in robes and holds an open book. The other figure, possibly an angel, has long wavy hair and holds a scroll. Rays of light emanate above the central figure. The background consists of swirling clouds. The upper right corner of the image shows the year "1539" and an artist's monogram.
